title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. translated_title: MFG：多轮反馈引导的分子优化
translated_abstract: 多目标分子优化是药物发现中的关键过程，其目标是在保持整体结构相似的前提下修改给定分子，以同时改善多种性质。这一过程通常需要在计算或实验反馈的指导下进行迭代修改。近来基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法已开始探索这种迭代方式；然而，这些方法并未经过显式训练来利用此类反馈，且现有方法主要聚焦于单轮分子优化。为填补这一空白，我们提出了多轮反馈引导（MFG）分子优化，这是一个强化学习框架，通过训练LLM利用先前轮次的反馈来逐步优化分子。MFG引入了一个同时捕捉性质改善程度和与源分子相似性的反馈向量，并配套一个与反馈对齐的奖励函数，以促进渐进式改进（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出MFG强化学习框架，通过引入捕捉性质改善与结构相似性的反馈向量及与反馈对齐的奖励函数，训练大语言模型利用多轮反馈逐步优化分子，突破了现有方法未显式学习反馈利用且仅支持单轮优化的局限。
en_tdlr: MFG is a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to progressively optimize molecules over multiple turns by leveraging a feedback vector capturing property improvements and source-molecule similarity, along with a feedback-aligned reward function.
